title: Relation — structural placeholder
description: An exact supported connection among terms that remain distinct; a one-sided record does not establish reciprocity.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

terms.description: Exact distinct terms participating in the claimed relation.

kind.description: Kind of connection claimed, without silent conversion into another kind.

direction.description: Local, reciprocal, or shared extent actually supported; no reciprocity inferred from a link.

basis_by_side.description: Valid local basis supplied by every relevant side for what is attributed to it.

scope.description: Exact target, function, and supported effects.

asymmetry.description: Visible differences in dependence, knowledge, capability, responsibility, or other relevant dimensions.

exit_and_correction.description: Supported refusal, withdrawal, correction, suspension, and ending at the relation's scope.

uncertainty.description: Missing support without presumed consent, merger, or ownership.
